A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same work, with readable text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D. Full-document text and rendered-page comparisons support a reliable assessment.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of DOOR and W-DOOR on Llama-3-8B and Gemma-2-2B, including attack success rates, utility measurements, ablations, and model-behavior analyses in Section 5 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix B, including Table 1 and the safety, utility, and ablation figures.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same harmful-prefix augmentation, DOOR combination of refusal training and NPO, W-DOOR token weighting, and utility-retention objective. Equation 3 changes only the capitalization of the total-loss subscript.

E1.justification: Both retain SORRY-Bench, HEx-PHI, and Alpaca training coverage; prefilling, multi-turn, and HarmBench suffix attacks; and XSTest, MMLU, and HellaSwag evaluations. Appendix A documents the same coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding tables and figures. SFT, DPO, NPO, GA, RR, TAR, the original models, and augmentation variants remain in their respective comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A retain the same splits, sample counts, models, attack-generation procedures, metrics, and training settings, including 10 epochs, batch size 2, and learning rate 1e-5. Appendix C retains the same evaluation prompts.

E4.justification: The augmentation and token-weight ablations, checkpoint Pareto analyses, KL-divergence and representation analyses, reward visualizations, and Appendix D examples are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. Neither version supplies repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 1, result figures, and appendix examples retain identical results. For example, W-DOOR prefilling ASR remains 0.034 for Llama-3-8B and 0.005 for Gemma-2-2B in Table 1. No result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The DPO and DOOR gradient derivations, loss definitions, and token-weight formulas are unchanged. Changing L_total to L_Total in Equation 3 is equivalent notation and does not revise mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contribution claims concerning dual-objective alignment, token-weighted refusal learning, jailbreak robustness, utility preservation, and relationships to token distributions and internal representations.

C2.justification: Sections 5 and 7 retain the same mechanism interpretations and qualifications concerning multi-turn robustness, over-refusal, reward stability, augmentation design, and future attack coverage.

D1.justification: The implementation settings, hardware disclosures, data-construction instructions, benchmark configurations, judge prompts, and code/data access information are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices A, C, and D.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain unchanged, including Section 6's relationships to DPO, refusal training, unlearning, and other jailbreak defenses.

P1.justification: v2 replaces 'Preprint.' with an ICML 2025/PMLR proceedings and copyright notice, updates the arXiv version/date stamp, and capitalizes the total-loss subscript in Equation 3. The scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer publication notice causes limited text reflow across pages 1–2, and Equation 3 is slightly retypeset. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 updates publication metadata and makes a cosmetic notation adjustment. The scientific content, empirical evidence, interpretations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including the appendices. These limited presentation edits produce no meaningful net difference in paper quality.
